text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

SOYBEAN SALE - South Korea's state-run Agricultural and Fishery Marketing Corp bought 20,000 tonnes of U.S. No 1 soybeans at $338.27 per tonne, C and F. Daewoo International (America) Corp won the contract with shipment for September 26-October 15 if from the U.S. Gulf or October 11-30 if from PNW. Arrival was set for Inchon by November 20.
WHEAT SALES - A Philippine flour mill bought 25,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for prompt delivery. There were no other details.

WHEAT SALES - Korea Flour Milling Corp bought 17,300 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from United Grain Corp. Prices were from $184.10 to $197.40 a tonne. Shipment was for December 10-January 10 from PNW to Inchon.

- Two South Korean flour mills, Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd and Cheiljedang Corp, bought 22,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Japanese trading house Marubeni Corp. Shipment was set for December 10-January 10 from the PNW to the western port city of Inchon.

WHEAT SALES - Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade has offered 70,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for sale, an official statement issued by the Gecpt said. It set September 10 as the final date to receive price offers and confirmation would be made on September 11 for October shipment.

CORN SALES - Taiwan's Members Feed Industry Group bought 56,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn from Zennoh Friday for October shipment. It paid $171.15 C and F for 38,000 tonnes and 99.73 cents over December futures for 18,000 tonnes.

CORN SALES - South Korea's National Livestock Cooperative Federation bought 105,000 tonnes of Argentine feed corn and passed on another 52,500 tonnes. An official with the federation said it initially invited a total of 157,500 tonnes of corn originating from the U.S. and Argentina. The amount was divided into three lots, each of 52,500 tonnes.
CORN TENDER - Jordan seeks 50,000 tonnes of U.S. Number 3 yellow corn in one lot for shipment in the first half of November. Offers must be received by September 25.
RICE TENDER - Ivory Coast will seek 29,000 tonnes of PL480 long grain brown rice for Oct 15-Nov 15 and/or Nov 15-Dec 15 shipment its U.S. agent said. Bids are due by Sept 11.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC will tender on Sept 12 for 8,000 tonnes of U.S. SRW wheat for donation to Jamaica.
- The CCC on Sept 10 seeks 19,860 tonnes of soft white wheat of which 15,340 is for donation to Ethiopia and 4,520 for Pakistan for Sept 25-Oct 20 shipment.

WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC seeks a total of 23,500 tonnes of U.S. wheat under the export donation program to Honduras. The deal includes 5,000 tonnes northern spring/dark northern spring wheat and 3,000 tonnes soft red winter wheat for November 1-25 shipment. It also includes 9,500 NS/DNS wheat and 6,000 tonnes SRW wheat slated for December 10-30 shipment. Offers are due on September 11.

MARKET TALK - State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp is expected to tender later next week for a combined shipment of 30,000 tonnes of U.S. corn and soybeans, they said. Traders said Taiwan Sugar was also expected to tender on September 13 for another 10,000-tonne corn shipment...Saudi Arabia has concluded a deal to buy some 800,000 tonnes of feed barley from the world market, with the European Union being awarded the lion's share, grain traders said...Thai oil crushers and feedmillers were expected soon to place orders for 49,000 tonnes of soybeans for November-December delivery, government officials and traders said on Friday...USDA said it will donate about 3,000 tonnes of soybean meal to a voluntary group to sell in Georgia to raise money to fund loans to farmers. It will also donate about 6,000 tonnes of vegetable oil to the United Methodist Committee on Relief to distribute in Armenia.
